enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 article tables, code, math and wide layouts › records every table and equation every published article renders, at both widths
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Sweeps every published article in the built export at 375x812 and 1440x900, finds each table's real scrolling ancestor by walking up to the first computed scroll container rather than trusting a selector, proves the scroll by moving it and restoring it, checks the container is reachable by keyboard wherever it actually scrolls, and reads each equation's MathML, TeX annotation, hidden glyph layer and rendered face.

enforcementTargets.title: article table and math evidence > refuses stale, incomplete, and vacuous dense-surface evidence
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the reader that gates both dense-surface rows throws on a stale fingerprint, the wrong viewports, a route set that disagrees with the module registry in either direction, a duplicated route/viewport pair, an empty page, a math-bearing article that rendered no equation, and a sweep that found no table or no equation at all, and proves the verdicts fail an unreachable scroll container, a table wider than its viewport, an unnamed table, a raw-TeX leak, a document that overflows sideways and a root that hides the overflow instead.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 article tables, code, math and wide layouts › records every table and equation every published article renders, at both widths
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Sweeps every published article in the built export at 375x812 and 1440x900, finds each table's real scrolling ancestor by walking up to the first computed scroll container rather than trusting a selector, proves the scroll by moving it and restoring it, checks the container is reachable by keyboard wherever it actually scrolls, and reads each equation's MathML, TeX annotation, hidden glyph layer and rendered face.

enforcementTargets.title: article table and math evidence > refuses stale, incomplete, and vacuous dense-surface evidence
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the reader that gates both dense-surface rows throws on a stale fingerprint, the wrong viewports, a route set that disagrees with the module registry in either direction, a duplicated route/viewport pair, an empty page, a math-bearing article that rendered no equation, and a sweep that found no table or no equation at all, and proves the verdicts fail an unreachable scroll container, a table wider than its viewport, an unnamed table, a raw-TeX leak, a document that overflows sideways and a root that hides the overflow instead.

enforcementTargets.title: design tokens stay aligned > compares the shared renderer constants against the sealed values
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Compares every renderer mirror constant against the sealed palette and against the matching --color-* declaration in app/globals.css, so a wrong mirror literal fails instead of propagating.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 core visual authority › every public route resolves the sealed palette exactly
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Loads every registered public route, compares the resolved :root colour tokens and their aliases against the contract-derived values exactly, and persists the observation this row reads.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 core visual authority › runtime signal token resolves to exact v2 blue
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Measures the resolved signal, focus, and selection tokens in a live document.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 token evidence > records the colours the shipped card corpus paints and the renderer mirror parity
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Walks every shipped Open Graph card, records the painted colours and the mirror-versus-authored-stylesheet comparison this row reads, and fails when the artwork paints a value the stylesheet authors for no token.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 token evidence > the renderer identity over a fixture tree > fails a render boundary that does not hand the opened tree straight to the renderer
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Plants a wrapper at the render call site, a wrapper behind a helper, an in-place edit between opening the seal and rendering, a substituted tree, a boundary that never opens the seal, and a generator that bypasses the boundary, and requires each to be rejected, so the painted tree cannot differ from the corpus tree this row measures.

enforcementTargets.title: the sealed Open Graph card corpus > refuses a card tree edited in place after it was sealed
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the corpus handle carries no route to the element tree, that a forged or copied handle is refused, and that a tree edited after sealing can no longer be opened, which is what leaves the render boundary no reachable tree to transform.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 token evidence > rejects spoofed, stale, and incomplete token evidence
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Feeds the readers artifacts with a stale fingerprint, a missing route, an unmeasured property, a disagreeing hex, a wrong card count, and a drifted mirror, and requires each to be rejected.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 core visual authority › every public route resolves the sealed palette exactly
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Loads every registered public route, compares the resolved :root colour tokens and their aliases against the contract-derived values exactly, and persists the observation this row reads.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 core visual authority › runtime signal token resolves to exact v2 blue
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Measures the resolved signal, focus, and selection tokens in a live document.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 token evidence > records the colours the shipped card corpus paints and the renderer mirror parity
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Walks every shipped Open Graph card, records the painted colours and the mirror-versus-authored-stylesheet comparison this row reads, and fails when the artwork paints a value the stylesheet authors for no token.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 token evidence > the renderer identity over a fixture tree > fails a render boundary that does not hand the opened tree straight to the renderer
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Plants a wrapper at the render call site, a wrapper behind a helper, an in-place edit between opening the seal and rendering, a substituted tree, a boundary that never opens the seal, and a generator that bypasses the boundary, and requires each to be rejected, so the painted tree cannot differ from the corpus tree this row measures.

enforcementTargets.title: the sealed Open Graph card corpus > refuses a card tree edited in place after it was sealed
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the corpus handle carries no route to the element tree, that a forged or copied handle is refused, and that a tree edited after sealing can no longer be opened, which is what leaves the render boundary no reachable tree to transform.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 token evidence > rejects spoofed, stale, and incomplete token evidence
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Feeds the readers artifacts with a stale fingerprint, a missing route, an unmeasured property, a disagreeing hex, a wrong card count, and a drifted mirror, and requires each to be rejected.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 global type, colour, spacing and component convergence › every public route is read at each page-frame width
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Loads every registry-derived public route in the built export at 375x812, 768x1024 and 1440x900, discovers actions, selections, links, inputs, cards, frames, citation marks, section heads, text runs and spacing values structurally from computed styles and the accessibility tree before reading any annotation, composites each label onto the ground it actually paints over, measures each section gap, inline inset, frame width and text box as laid out, and walks thirty real Tab stops reading the focus ring and whatever covers the focused control.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 global type, colour, spacing and component convergence › the global verdicts fail independently when their subjects are broken
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Plants each route predicate on the last registered route of the corpus just measured and requires exactly the rows that own it to fail that route and no other, plants a signal-blue keyboard ring, an unregistered 7 px margin, an 8 px inset, a 40 px section gap, a 1100 px paragraph, an unowned h1, a word-broken heading and a covered focus stop against the frame rows, and a Tektur tuple into each type population, then proves the reader refuses a dropped route, a missing route/viewport reading, a stale fingerprint and an empty population.

enforcementTargets.title: global convergence evidence > refuses stale, incomplete, and vacuous convergence evidence
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the reader that gates all seventeen rows throws on a wrong version, a stale fingerprint, a dropped, extra or duplicated route, a missing viewport, a non-200 page, an empty page, a short keyboard trace, an exemption the register does not hold or does not grant for that predicate, route, property or value, a register clause the sweep never used, and an empty population.

enforcementTargets.title: global convergence evidence > fails each planted violation under the rows that own it
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves on a synthetic sweep that every route predicate, an off-ink, too-wide or unexcused offset keyboard ring, each spacing, separation, frame-geometry, ownership and collision defect, and a tuple outside each sealed type population fails its own row and member, and that an exempted finding fails nothing.

machinePredicate.expected: Every primary action has ink/black fill and an accessible light label; signal-blue-filled primary actions are absent.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 global type, colour, spacing and component convergence › every public route is read at each page-frame width
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Loads every registry-derived public route in the built export at 375x812, 768x1024 and 1440x900, discovers actions, selections, links, inputs, cards, frames, citation marks, section heads, text runs and spacing values structurally from computed styles and the accessibility tree before reading any annotation, composites each label onto the ground it actually paints over, measures each section gap, inline inset, frame width and text box as laid out, and walks thirty real Tab stops reading the focus ring and whatever covers the focused control.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 global type, colour, spacing and component convergence › the global verdicts fail independently when their subjects are broken
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Plants each route predicate on the last registered route of the corpus just measured and requires exactly the rows that own it to fail that route and no other, plants a signal-blue keyboard ring, an unregistered 7 px margin, an 8 px inset, a 40 px section gap, a 1100 px paragraph, an unowned h1, a word-broken heading and a covered focus stop against the frame rows, and a Tektur tuple into each type population, then proves the reader refuses a dropped route, a missing route/viewport reading, a stale fingerprint and an empty population.

enforcementTargets.title: global convergence evidence > refuses stale, incomplete, and vacuous convergence evidence
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the reader that gates all seventeen rows throws on a wrong version, a stale fingerprint, a dropped, extra or duplicated route, a missing viewport, a non-200 page, an empty page, a short keyboard trace, an exemption the register does not hold or does not grant for that predicate, route, property or value, a register clause the sweep never used, and an empty population.

enforcementTargets.title: global convergence evidence > fails each planted violation under the rows that own it
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves on a synthetic sweep that every route predicate, an off-ink, too-wide or unexcused offset keyboard ring, each spacing, separation, frame-geometry, ownership and collision defect, and a tuple outside each sealed type population fails its own row and member, and that an exempted finding fails nothing.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 global type, colour, spacing and component convergence › every public route is read at each page-frame width
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Loads every registry-derived public route in the built export at 375x812, 768x1024 and 1440x900, discovers actions, selections, links, inputs, cards, frames, citation marks, section heads, text runs and spacing values structurally from computed styles and the accessibility tree before reading any annotation, composites each label onto the ground it actually paints over, measures each section gap, inline inset, frame width and text box as laid out, and walks thirty real Tab stops reading the focus ring and whatever covers the focused control.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 global type, colour, spacing and component convergence › the global verdicts fail independently when their subjects are broken
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Plants each route predicate on the last registered route of the corpus just measured and requires exactly the rows that own it to fail that route and no other, plants a signal-blue keyboard ring, an unregistered 7 px margin, an 8 px inset, a 40 px section gap, a 1100 px paragraph, an unowned h1, a word-broken heading and a covered focus stop against the frame rows, and a Tektur tuple into each type population, then proves the reader refuses a dropped route, a missing route/viewport reading, a stale fingerprint and an empty population.

enforcementTargets.title: global convergence evidence > refuses stale, incomplete, and vacuous convergence evidence
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the reader that gates all seventeen rows throws on a wrong version, a stale fingerprint, a dropped, extra or duplicated route, a missing viewport, a non-200 page, an empty page, a short keyboard trace, an exemption the register does not hold or does not grant for that predicate, route, property or value, a register clause the sweep never used, and an empty population.

enforcementTargets.title: global convergence evidence > fails each planted violation under the rows that own it
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves on a synthetic sweep that every route predicate, an off-ink, too-wide or unexcused offset keyboard ring, each spacing, separation, frame-geometry, ownership and collision defect, and a tuple outside each sealed type population fails its own row and member, and that an exempted finding fails nothing.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 global type, colour, spacing and component convergence › every public route is read at each page-frame width
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Loads every registry-derived public route in the built export at 375x812, 768x1024 and 1440x900, discovers actions, selections, links, inputs, cards, frames, citation marks, section heads, text runs and spacing values structurally from computed styles and the accessibility tree before reading any annotation, composites each label onto the ground it actually paints over, measures each section gap, inline inset, frame width and text box as laid out, and walks thirty real Tab stops reading the focus ring and whatever covers the focused control.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 global type, colour, spacing and component convergence › the global verdicts fail independently when their subjects are broken
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Plants each route predicate on the last registered route of the corpus just measured and requires exactly the rows that own it to fail that route and no other, plants a signal-blue keyboard ring, an unregistered 7 px margin, an 8 px inset, a 40 px section gap, a 1100 px paragraph, an unowned h1, a word-broken heading and a covered focus stop against the frame rows, and a Tektur tuple into each type population, then proves the reader refuses a dropped route, a missing route/viewport reading, a stale fingerprint and an empty population.

enforcementTargets.title: global convergence evidence > refuses stale, incomplete, and vacuous convergence evidence
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the reader that gates all seventeen rows throws on a wrong version, a stale fingerprint, a dropped, extra or duplicated route, a missing viewport, a non-200 page, an empty page, a short keyboard trace, an exemption the register does not hold or does not grant for that predicate, route, property or value, a register clause the sweep never used, and an empty population.

enforcementTargets.title: global convergence evidence > fails each planted violation under the rows that own it
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves on a synthetic sweep that every route predicate, an off-ink, too-wide or unexcused offset keyboard ring, each spacing, separation, frame-geometry, ownership and collision defect, and a tuple outside each sealed type population fails its own row and member, and that an exempted finding fails nothing.

machinePredicate.statement: Neither the neutral highlight grey nor the signal blue is used as a success semantic, and colour is never the sole carrier of state.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 global type, colour, spacing and component convergence › every public route is read at each page-frame width
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Loads every registry-derived public route in the built export at 375x812, 768x1024 and 1440x900, discovers actions, selections, links, inputs, cards, frames, citation marks, section heads, text runs and spacing values structurally from computed styles and the accessibility tree before reading any annotation, composites each label onto the ground it actually paints over, measures each section gap, inline inset, frame width and text box as laid out, and walks thirty real Tab stops reading the focus ring and whatever covers the focused control.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 global type, colour, spacing and component convergence › the global verdicts fail independently when their subjects are broken
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Plants each route predicate on the last registered route of the corpus just measured and requires exactly the rows that own it to fail that route and no other, plants a signal-blue keyboard ring, an unregistered 7 px margin, an 8 px inset, a 40 px section gap, a 1100 px paragraph, an unowned h1, a word-broken heading and a covered focus stop against the frame rows, and a Tektur tuple into each type population, then proves the reader refuses a dropped route, a missing route/viewport reading, a stale fingerprint and an empty population.

enforcementTargets.title: global convergence evidence > refuses stale, incomplete, and vacuous convergence evidence
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the reader that gates all seventeen rows throws on a wrong version, a stale fingerprint, a dropped, extra or duplicated route, a missing viewport, a non-200 page, an empty page, a short keyboard trace, an exemption the register does not hold or does not grant for that predicate, route, property or value, a register clause the sweep never used, and an empty population.

enforcementTargets.title: global convergence evidence > fails each planted violation under the rows that own it
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves on a synthetic sweep that every route predicate, an off-ink, too-wide or unexcused offset keyboard ring, each spacing, separation, frame-geometry, ownership and collision defect, and a tuple outside each sealed type population fails its own row and member, and that an exempted finding fails nothing.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 global type, colour, spacing and component convergence › the global verdicts fail independently when their subjects are broken

enforcementTargets.title: global convergence evidence > refuses stale, incomplete, and vacuous convergence evidence
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the reader that gates all seventeen rows throws on a wrong version, a stale fingerprint, a dropped, extra or duplicated route, a missing viewport, a non-200 page, an empty page, a short keyboard trace, an exemption the register does not hold or does not grant for that predicate, route, property or value, a register clause the sweep never used, and an empty population.

enforcementTargets.title: global convergence evidence > fails each planted violation under the rows that own it
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves on a synthetic sweep that every route predicate, an off-ink, too-wide or unexcused offset keyboard ring, each spacing, separation, frame-geometry, ownership and collision defect, and a tuple outside each sealed type population fails its own row and member, and that an exempted finding fails nothing.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 global type, colour, spacing and component convergence › every public route is read at each page-frame width
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Loads every registry-derived public route in the built export at 375x812, 768x1024 and 1440x900, discovers actions, selections, links, inputs, cards, frames, citation marks, section heads, text runs and spacing values structurally from computed styles and the accessibility tree before reading any annotation, composites each label onto the ground it actually paints over, measures each section gap, inline inset, frame width and text box as laid out, and walks thirty real Tab stops reading the focus ring and whatever covers the focused control.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 global type, colour, spacing and component convergence › the global verdicts fail independently when their subjects are broken
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Plants each route predicate on the last registered route of the corpus just measured and requires exactly the rows that own it to fail that route and no other, plants a signal-blue keyboard ring, an unregistered 7 px margin, an 8 px inset, a 40 px section gap, a 1100 px paragraph, an unowned h1, a word-broken heading and a covered focus stop against the frame rows, and a Tektur tuple into each type population, then proves the reader refuses a dropped route, a missing route/viewport reading, a stale fingerprint and an empty population.

enforcementTargets.title: global convergence evidence > refuses stale, incomplete, and vacuous convergence evidence
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the reader that gates all seventeen rows throws on a wrong version, a stale fingerprint, a dropped, extra or duplicated route, a missing viewport, a non-200 page, an empty page, a short keyboard trace, an exemption the register does not hold or does not grant for that predicate, route, property or value, a register clause the sweep never used, and an empty population.

enforcementTargets.title: global convergence evidence > fails each planted violation under the rows that own it
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves on a synthetic sweep that every route predicate, an off-ink, too-wide or unexcused offset keyboard ring, each spacing, separation, frame-geometry, ownership and collision defect, and a tuple outside each sealed type population fails its own row and member, and that an exempted finding fails nothing.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 global type, colour, spacing and component convergence › every public route is read at each page-frame width
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Loads every registry-derived public route in the built export at 375x812, 768x1024 and 1440x900, discovers actions, selections, links, inputs, cards, frames, citation marks, section heads, text runs and spacing values structurally from computed styles and the accessibility tree before reading any annotation, composites each label onto the ground it actually paints over, measures each section gap, inline inset, frame width and text box as laid out, and walks thirty real Tab stops reading the focus ring and whatever covers the focused control.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 global type, colour, spacing and component convergence › the global verdicts fail independently when their subjects are broken
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Plants each route predicate on the last registered route of the corpus just measured and requires exactly the rows that own it to fail that route and no other, plants a signal-blue keyboard ring, an unregistered 7 px margin, an 8 px inset, a 40 px section gap, a 1100 px paragraph, an unowned h1, a word-broken heading and a covered focus stop against the frame rows, and a Tektur tuple into each type population, then proves the reader refuses a dropped route, a missing route/viewport reading, a stale fingerprint and an empty population.

enforcementTargets.title: global convergence evidence > refuses stale, incomplete, and vacuous convergence evidence
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the reader that gates all seventeen rows throws on a wrong version, a stale fingerprint, a dropped, extra or duplicated route, a missing viewport, a non-200 page, an empty page, a short keyboard trace, an exemption the register does not hold or does not grant for that predicate, route, property or value, a register clause the sweep never used, and an empty population.

enforcementTargets.title: global convergence evidence > fails each planted violation under the rows that own it
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves on a synthetic sweep that every route predicate, an off-ink, too-wide or unexcused offset keyboard ring, each spacing, separation, frame-geometry, ownership and collision defect, and a tuple outside each sealed type population fails its own row and member, and that an exempted finding fails nothing.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 global type, colour, spacing and component convergence › every public route is read at each page-frame width
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Loads every registry-derived public route in the built export at 375x812, 768x1024 and 1440x900, discovers actions, selections, links, inputs, cards, frames, citation marks, section heads, text runs and spacing values structurally from computed styles and the accessibility tree before reading any annotation, composites each label onto the ground it actually paints over, measures each section gap, inline inset, frame width and text box as laid out, and walks thirty real Tab stops reading the focus ring and whatever covers the focused control.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 global type, colour, spacing and component convergence › the global verdicts fail independently when their subjects are broken
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Plants each route predicate on the last registered route of the corpus just measured and requires exactly the rows that own it to fail that route and no other, plants a signal-blue keyboard ring, an unregistered 7 px margin, an 8 px inset, a 40 px section gap, a 1100 px paragraph, an unowned h1, a word-broken heading and a covered focus stop against the frame rows, and a Tektur tuple into each type population, then proves the reader refuses a dropped route, a missing route/viewport reading, a stale fingerprint and an empty population.

enforcementTargets.title: global convergence evidence > refuses stale, incomplete, and vacuous convergence evidence
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the reader that gates all seventeen rows throws on a wrong version, a stale fingerprint, a dropped, extra or duplicated route, a missing viewport, a non-200 page, an empty page, a short keyboard trace, an exemption the register does not hold or does not grant for that predicate, route, property or value, a register clause the sweep never used, and an empty population.

enforcementTargets.title: global convergence evidence > fails each planted violation under the rows that own it
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves on a synthetic sweep that every route predicate, an off-ink, too-wide or unexcused offset keyboard ring, each spacing, separation, frame-geometry, ownership and collision defect, and a tuple outside each sealed type population fails its own row and member, and that an exempted finding fails nothing.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 public identity › every public route renders the exact v2 identity at both identity viewports
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Sweeps every registry-derived public route at the desktop-shell and mobile-header viewports, discovers brand lockups structurally by the whole `robot wiki` spelling family before reading any annotation, and records the rendered names, descriptor slots, wordmark families and axes, icon declarations, in-lockup symbol nodes, and prose metadata that decide the six identity rows.

enforcementTargets.title: identity runtime evidence > refuses stale, incomplete, and unmeasured identity evidence
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the reader that gates every identity row throws on a stale fingerprint, a missing route, a missing viewport, an empty page, and a route with no discovered lockup, so a green row cannot survive an artifact that did not measure the tree it is committed against.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 public identity › every public route renders the exact v2 identity at both identity viewports
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Sweeps every registry-derived public route at the desktop-shell and mobile-header viewports, discovers brand lockups structurally by the whole `robot wiki` spelling family before reading any annotation, and records the rendered names, descriptor slots, wordmark families and axes, icon declarations, in-lockup symbol nodes, and prose metadata that decide the six identity rows.

enforcementTargets.title: identity runtime evidence > refuses stale, incomplete, and unmeasured identity evidence
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the reader that gates every identity row throws on a stale fingerprint, a missing route, a missing viewport, an empty page, and a route with no discovered lockup, so a green row cannot survive an artifact that did not measure the tree it is committed against.

enforcementTargets.title: first-party visual asset seal > ships exactly the approved asset set
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Reconciles the first-party visual assets discovered by the census walk of public/ against contract/brand-v2-asset-seal.json in both directions and re-hashes every one, and proves the reconciliation refuses an asset present in the tree with no sealed entry, a sealed entry the tree does not ship, and an approved path carrying different bytes — including the wide, labelled robot-head SVG the deleted subject heuristics accepted.

machinePredicate.statement: The repository introduces no first-party symbol, monogram, mascot, robot-head logo, or alternate brand glyph.
machinePredicate.expected: The repository introduces no first-party symbol, monogram, mascot, robot-head logo, or alternate brand glyph.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 home composition › home renders one dominant lockup, a black action, a lime highlight, and all seven domain destinations
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Loads the built home page at 1440x900, discovers its hero lockups both by heading level and by the wordmark type role so a duplicate that is not an h1 is still found, resolves the descriptor by computed font family rather than by class name, finds the lime highlights by computed paint on every element in main rather than by an annotation the page could omit, reads the registered primary action’s composited background and label colour with the pointer parked off the composition, measures every canonical domain row’s box, and records the section signatures, the taxonomy anchor counts and the progress-copy matches.

enforcementTargets.title: home composition evidence > refuses stale, incomplete, and unmeasured home evidence
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the reader that gates all three home rows throws on a stale fingerprint, a wrong version, a wrong viewport, a wrong route, an empty rendered page, a sweep with no hero lockup, no domain entry and no section, and proves the verdicts fail a duplicate lockup, a reworded descriptor, a hero under the dominance ratio, a black action pushed below the fold, a lime mark carried by colour alone, an unregistered section, a four-run of identical signatures, a bordered domain card, a progress phrase and a dropped domain destination.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 mobile header and drawer › every public route omits the descriptor from the compact header and traps the drawer in both directions
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Sweeps every registry-derived public route at the mobile-header viewport, discovers the compact lockup structurally by the whole `robot wiki` spelling family before reading any annotation, reads the header leaf text rather than its source, then opens the drawer three times per route: once to press a real Tab off its last stop and a real Shift+Tab off its first and read where focus landed, once to dismiss it with the close control, and once to dismiss it with the scrim, recording which regions the browser made inert and what the scrim composites to against the panel.

enforcementTargets.title: mobile shell evidence > refuses stale, incomplete, and unmeasured mobile shell evidence
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the reader that gates both mobile rows throws on a stale fingerprint, a wrong viewport, a missing route, an empty page, a header the sweep never found, a drawer with no tab stops, a keyboard trace with no destination and a missing dismissal path, and proves the verdicts fail a one-way trap, an escaped skip link, a descriptor in the header and a scrim that composites to the panel colour.

enforcementTargets.title: Open Graph corpus evidence > decides every row for every member of its population over the published corpus

enforcementTargets.title: Open Graph corpus evidence > refuses a recorded manifest the current tree and shipped bytes no longer rebuild
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Feeds the reader a manifest whose painted title, and then whose corpus hash, the current tree and shipped bytes no longer rebuild, and requires it to throw instead of reading the record.

enforcementTargets.title: Open Graph corpus evidence > refuses a recorded pixel reading that decoding the shipped card does not reproduce
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Feeds the reader a pixel record that decoding the shipped card does not reproduce and requires it to throw, so a row cannot rest on a pixel reading of other bytes.

enforcementTargets.title: Open Graph row verdicts > VAL-B2-ID-009 fails an article card that paints the descriptor and a site card that paints another identity
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Adds the descriptor to an article card and renames the site identity, and proves the verdict fails each.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 OG authority › VAL-B2-ID-009 drawn card artwork carries the exact v2 identity

enforcementTargets.title: decoded Open Graph card pixels > fails a card whose identity region was left blank
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Blanks the identity region of a decoded card and proves the pixel inspection fails it, so the identity ink count is a reading.

enforcementTargets.title: Open Graph corpus evidence > decides every row for every member of its population over the published corpus
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Reads the published corpus through the reader every Open Graph row uses and decides each row for every member of its population, with every image payload hashed from the shipped file.

enforcementTargets.title: Open Graph corpus evidence > refuses a recorded manifest the current tree and shipped bytes no longer rebuild
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Feeds the reader a manifest whose painted title, and then whose corpus hash, the current tree and shipped bytes no longer rebuild, and requires it to throw instead of reading the record.

enforcementTargets.title: Open Graph corpus evidence > refuses a destination set that is not the sealed one and a route the export lacks
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Feeds the reader a registry route set missing a sealed site-card destination and holding a route the export never wrote, and requires both to be refused.

enforcementTargets.title: Open Graph row verdicts > VAL-B2-OG-009 fails a summary card, a relative or www image URL, a short alt and an X image unlike the Open Graph one
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Edits a route’s exported head six ways and proves the verdict fails each.

enforcementTargets.title: social card metadata (VAL-DIST-001, VAL-DIST-004) › every route declares exactly one summary_large_image twitter:card (VAL-DIST-001)
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Reads every route’s rendered head for exactly one large-image card declaration.

enforcementTargets.title: OG card images › every published route declares a large-image card pointing at a real exported asset (VAL-DIST-002, VAL-DIST-005)
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Serves the static export and fetches every route’s declared card: 200, image/png, and the same bytes as the exported file.

enforcementTargets.title: og card vocabulary > produces alt text of at least 15 characters that is not the bare title
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the derived alt text is at least 15 characters and not the bare title.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 desktop shell and navigation › every public route marks its current route, opens on the skip link, and keeps the sealed taxonomy
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Sweeps every registry-derived public route at the desktop-shell viewport, collects every element carrying aria-current whatever its tag before reading any annotation, measures the current-route rail against its registered anchor with its colour, width, row height and accessible-name contribution, runs a Tab-then-Enter keyboard trace for the skip link, and hashes the all-expanded taxonomy against the sealed navigation baseline.

enforcementTargets.title: shell runtime evidence > refuses stale, incomplete, and unmeasured shell evidence
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the reader that gates every shell row throws on a stale fingerprint, a wrong viewport, a missing route, an empty page, a route with no discovered navigation, and an empty taxonomy ledger, and proves the current-route verdict fails a signal-blue mark, a colour-only difference, an unregistered marker and aria-current on a heading.

machinePredicate.statement: Active navigation uses ink and/or lime plus a non-colour marker. A route with a corresponding navigation item has exactly one `aria-current="page"` on that matching link; a route without a corresponding navigation item has none. A heading or unrelated element never receives `aria-current` merely to satisfy a count. The `Robot Wiki` wordmark lockups are exempt from the marker requirement and MUST NOT render the lime active-interval rail or any other accent bar on any route, including `/`, where the wordmark link keeps `aria-current="page"` without a marker (owner decision 2026-09-25, `owner-decision-no-wordmark-rail-20260925.md`); the exemption does not extend to taxonomy or standalone navigation entries.

enforcementTargets.title: brand-v2 mobile header and drawer › every public route omits the descriptor from the compact header and traps the drawer in both directions
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Sweeps every registry-derived public route at the mobile-header viewport, discovers the compact lockup structurally by the whole `robot wiki` spelling family before reading any annotation, reads the header leaf text rather than its source, then opens the drawer three times per route: once to press a real Tab off its last stop and a real Shift+Tab off its first and read where focus landed, once to dismiss it with the close control, and once to dismiss it with the scrim, recording which regions the browser made inert and what the scrim composites to against the panel.

enforcementTargets.title: mobile shell evidence > refuses stale, incomplete, and unmeasured mobile shell evidence
enforcementTargets.mechanism: Proves the reader that gates both mobile rows throws on a stale fingerprint, a wrong viewport, a missing route, an empty page, a header the sweep never found, a drawer with no tab stops, a keyboard trace with no destination and a missing dismissal path, and proves the verdicts fail a one-way trap, an escaped skip link, a descriptor in the header and a scrim that composites to the panel colour.

machinePredicate.statement: Mobile drawer traps focus, closes on Escape, restores focus to its trigger, and makes obscured content inert.
